questions.subject: WORLD_HISTORY
questions.topic: A kingdom's script that few can read
questions.learningObjective: Explain challenges of an undeciphered script

stimulus.body: A kingdom left thousands of inscriptions in a script no one has fully deciphered, so its history remains largely silent despite abundant evidence.

questions.stem: A source note on a kingdom's script that few can read reads: "Abundant evidence cannot yet be read as history" Using that evidence, what is the main consequence of an undeciphered script?

options.text: Abundant evidence cannot yet be read as history
The inscriptions contain no information
The kingdom never existed
Decipherment is impossible in principle
options.misconception: reads the evidence as Decipherment is impossible in principle instead of Abundant evidence cannot yet be read as history.

questions.explanation: An undeciphered script means abundant physical evidence cannot yet be converted into readable history, though decipherment may still be possible.
questions.hint: What is the gap between evidence and knowledge?

questions.explanation: Repeated copying introduces changes, so surviving copies may not match the original wording, requiring textual criticism.
